title: Adaptive Onboarding Playbook + Renewal Signals (Working)
body:
Purpose:
Provide a practical, adaptive 30/60/90 onboarding playbook that ties early adoption signals to renewal timing. This is a working doc for CS reps and solutions engineers to run fast pilots and elevate customers toward a committed Dedicated or Hosted plan.

Audience:
CSMs, Solutions Eng, AMs, Technical PMs, Customer Success Leaders

Notes to self:
- Focus on signals that are actionable by week 2. Keep runbooks short.
- We want both product usage signals and business impact signals.
- This doc intentionally mixes tactical checklist items with suggested email templates and a small renewal signal tracker.

Top-level success criteria (example):
- Technical: integration complete, end-to-end latency under target, model variant deployed to staging
- Adoption: 50 unique active users or 10k tokens/month in pilot by day 60
- Value: 3 customer-defined outcome metrics improving (time saved, conversion uplift, NPS)
- Commercial: renewal discussion scheduled by day 75, purchase intent captured by day 90

Health score components (suggested weights):
- Integration completeness 25%
- Active usage 30%
- Feature breadth (chat, embeddings, reranking) 15%
- Support tickets age/resolution 10%
- Business outcomes reported 20%

Phase A: Kickoff & Quick Wins (Day 0-30)
- Objectives: fast integration, identify 1-2 high-impact flows, prove SLA assumptions
- Stakeholders to map: technical lead, product owner, procurement lead, ops/security
- Must do checklist:
  - Kickoff meeting with success criteria and roles (agenda below)
  - Access: API keys, IP allowlist, test dataset samples
  - Baseline metrics captured (latency, cost per token, existing model outputs)
  - Smoke test: sample prompt bank, sanity outputs, edge-case handling
  - Decide go/no-go gating criteria for day 30
- CSM actions:
  - Send onboarding workbook and invite to weekly sync
  - Capture business objectives in one-line outcome statements

Phase B: Expansion & Adoption (Day 31-60)
- Objectives: broaden integration surface, validate value, establish routing/cache settings
- Tech tasks:
  - Integrate streaming endpoints and function calling if needed
  - Enable prefix caching or KV cache for repeat prompts
  - Implement basic cost controls and quota for pilot users
- Adoption tasks:
  - Run 2 enablement sessions for end users
  - Add 5 representative prompts to test suite and start regression tracking
- Success signals to watch for:
  - Daily active usage trend up 20% week over week
  - Error rate < 2% on inference calls

Phase C: Stabilize & Commercialize (Day 61-90)
- Objectives: stabilize SLOs, quantify ROI, execute renewal path
- Deliverables:
  - Executive 30/60/90 summary for customer stakeholders
  - Run a QBR style review: outcomes, usage, cost analysis, next steps
  - Proposal draft for renewal/expansion with recommended capacity/quantization options
- Renewal signals (positive):
  - Exec sponsor asks about committed capacity or SLA
  - Usage exceeds burst capacity for 2 consecutive weeks
  - Customer requests price or capacity planning details
- Close-risk signals (negative):
  - Stalled integration tickets > 2 weeks
  - Active users plateauing and < 50 by day 60
  - Negative qualitative feedback in support threads

Meeting templates
- Kickoff agenda (60m): intros, success criteria, security checklist, tech leads, timeline, decision gates
- Weekly sync (30m): blockers, health score update, action items, tech deep dive as needed
- 30-Day checkpoint (45m): smoke test results, initial adoption metrics, adjustments
- 60-Day QBR (60m): usage trends, ROI evidence, renewal conversation kickoff

Email snippets
- Kickoff invite subject: Redwood onboarding kickoff for [Customer]
- Quick invite body: Hi [Name], attaching the onboarding workbook. Proposed dates for weekly syncs. Goal: get a working end-to-end flow in 14 days.
- Renewal intro subject (day 70): Planning next steps and projected capacity needs

Renewal tracker (quick view)
- Renewal window start: day 75 recommended
- Required artifacts for renewal:
  - Executive summary of outcomes
  - Technical runbook and SLO history
  - Cost projection (current pilot vs committed capacity)
- Renewal readiness checklist:
  - Exec review scheduled: yes/no
  - Procurement loop opened: yes/no
  - Proposed SKU and pricing: draft/approved

Risk mitigation playbooks
- If integration stalls:
  - Escalate to SE on call, run 90-minute diagnostic, deliver hotfix or workaround
- If usage flatlines:
  - Run targeted enablement campaign, highlight five high-value prompts, offer onsite training
- If quality regressions detected:
  - Rollback model variant and open model-quality eval; run paired comparison tests

Metrics instrumentation
- Dashboard widgets suggested:
  - Tokens per day, Unique call sites, Average latency by route, Error rate, Cost per 1k tokens
  - Business metric overlay (conversions, throughput)

Unresolved questions / TODOs
- Decide default health score thresholds for green/amber/red
- Validate whether procurement cadence is longer for mid-market vs enterprise customers
- Add small template for legal/compliance pre-checklist (security questionnaire link)

Related links and references
- Confluence onboarding checklist: https://confluence.redwood.ai/pages/ONB-123
- Pilot templates and evaluation harness: https://github.com/redwood-inference/pilot-harness
- Customer slack channel: #cs-onboarding

Version notes
- v0.1 initial working draft - Marisol
- v0.2 added renewal signal tracker - Evan

End of doc. Keep short notes in Slack, avoid long PDFs. This should stay a living doc and be pruned after each closed pilot.
